messages:
Samira (sec): Heads-up — after yesterday's permissions pruning I’m seeing a spike of 403s for private control plane UI reads from some dedicated tenants. Anyone else?
Matt (infra): saw alerts from the routing team, digging. which permission is failing?
Samira (sec): example from audit-bot: `error: forbidden: missing permission private.controlplane.view on resource tenant/alpha`
Rocio (sre): we’ve been getting customer tickets: metrics/trace pages 403. Not universal, looks like service accounts with 'service-admin' role mostly.
June (prod-sec): did the role pruning script remove any role bindings to the legacy `service-admin` perm set? I know we collapsed a couple roles last week.
Samira (sec): yep, pruning run at 03:12 UTC removed bindings flagged as unused. I have the run-id: prune-2026-03-19-0312.
Samira (sec): audit-bot snippet:
```
{"time":"2026-03-19T03:14:07Z","actor":"prune-runner","action":"remove_binding","target":"tenant/alpha:service-admin","binding_id":"b-7782"}
{"time":"2026-03-19T03:14:08Z","actor":"prune-runner","action":"remove_binding","target":"tenant/beta:service-admin","binding_id":"b-7783"}
```
Matt (infra): hmm. The new private control plane relies on a scoped permission `private.controlplane.view` which we mapped to `service-admin` historically. When we remapped roles we planned to add an explicit `private-controlplane-reader` role, but that migration job failed early.
June (prod-sec): that sounds like a migration gap. Did the migration job log an error?
Samira (sec): migration job `rbac-migrate-2026-03-18` shows: `ERROR: missing role-definition for private-controlplane-reader -> aborting`
Rocio (sre): quick mitigation: re-add the binding for affected tenants to restore dashboard access. We should do that as a canary for alpha.
Matt (infra): agree. I'll run `redwoodctl rbac grant --tenant alpha --role private-controlplane-reader --principals svc-account:analytics` now.
Matt (infra): done for alpha, rocio can you confirm ticketers?
Rocio (sre): confirmed alpha metrics page loads again for svc-account:analytics :thumbsup:
Samira (sec): thanks. For beta, there are also KMS errors logged when fetching wrapped keys for audit export: `KeyWrapException: principal not authorized to unwrap key key://kms/tenant-beta-logs`
June (prod-sec): that suggests the principal lost its KMS keywrap policy during pruning as well. The KMS policies are attached to service-roles via role-to-key bindings.
Samira (sec): right — the role-to-key binding was stored in role-meta for `service-admin` which got removed.
Matt (infra): short-term: add the KMS binding to the new role: `kmsctl grant-keywrap --key tenant-beta-logs --role private-controlplane-reader`
Matt (infra): also re-run the migration with the missing role-definition fixed. I'll patch and kick off `rbac-migrate-2026-03-19-fix`.
Samira (sec): capture follow-ups: 1) roll back pruning job for any tenant with >5 403s in last hour, 2) add unit tests for role->kms binding migration, 3) add alerting on migration abort states.
June (prod-sec): logging/telemetry note: split audit logs for role changes should include old-role, new-role and any key bindings so we can reconcile automatically.
Rocio (sre): I opened incident INC-2026-1140 for customer impact and added alpha/beta as affected.
Samira (sec): thanks. After infra confirms migration success we should run a targeted sweep to reconcile role-meta -> kms bindings across private/dedicated fleets.
Matt (infra): will do. ETA for full reconcile: ~3 hours. I’ll post updates.
audit-bot: Automation: scheduled job `rbac-prune` paused for tenants with active incidents.
Samira (sec): perfect. tagging @matt @june for postmortem and a short RFC for safer pruning/migrations.
Matt (infra): noted — will draft RFC for 'prune+migration transactional guarantees' and link migration logs.
June (prod-sec): adding test plan for KMS-binding migration to the RFC.
Rocio (sre): closing loop on customer tickets once reconcile done.
Samira (sec): thanks team. keeping thread for PM/ops notes.
